fullContentHtml:
Short Information : Uttarakhand Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UKSSSC) has released the notification for the Assistant Accountant and Other Post. This recruitment has been issued for 63 posts. Online applying process for UKSSSC Assistant Accountant and Other Post Recruitment 2025 has started from 05 April 2025 & the candidates can apply till 29 April 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for UKSSSC Assistant Accountant and Other Post Recruitment 2025 which has given below. 

Uttarakhand Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UKSSSC)

UKSSSC Assistant Accountant and Other Post Recruitment 2025

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 05 April 2025
  • Last Date : 29 April 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 29 April 2025
  • Correction Date : 05-07 May 2025
  • Exam Date : 06 – 07 May 2025
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC : Rs. 300/-
  • SC, ST, EWS : Rs. 150/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

UKSSSC Assistant Accountant and Other Post Notification 2025 : Age Limit

  • Age Limit As On 01 October 2024
  • Minimum Age : 18-21 Years
  • Maximum Age : 42 Years
  • Age Relaxation as per UKSSSC Assistant Accountant and Other Post Recruitment Rules.
  • Use Tool –

UKSSSC Assistant Accountant and Other Post 2025 : Vacancy Details

Total Posts : 63 Posts

Post Name No. of Post 
Assistant Accountant 57
Record Keeper-cum-Store Keeper 01

UKSSSC Assistant Accountant and Other Post Bharti 2025 : Educational Qualification

Post Name Eligibility 
Assistant Accountant
  • Graduation Degree in Commerce B.Com OR BBA OR Master in Accountancy.
  • Hindi Typing Speed : 4000 Key Depression Per Hour.
Record Keeper-cum-Store Keeper
  • 12 Intermediate Exam in Commerce Stream from Any Recognized Board in India.
  • Hindi Typing Speed : 4000 Key Depression Per Hour.
Office Assistant III (Accounts)
  • Graduation Degree in Commerce with Hindi Devnagari Lipi Knowledge.
  • Hindi Typing Speed 6000 Key Depression per Hour
  • English Typing Speed 7000 Key Depression Per Hour
Cashier Data Entry Operator
  • 12 Intermediate Exam in Commerce With Accountancy Any Recognized Board in India.
  • 4000 Key Depressions Per Hour and MS Office Knowledge

UKSSSC Assistant Accountant and Other Post Online Form 2025 : How To Apply

  • Candidates can apply through link https://sssc.uk.gov.in/ or provided below in link section or they can also apply through official site of the UKSSSC before Last Date.
  • You Can Check other Sarkari Result 2025 Notification Here – Check Now.
  • For all the interested and eligible candidates who want to apply for UKSSSC Assistant Accountant and Other Post recruitment can read all the information related to the recruitment is given below and the link to apply is given in the Important Link section below.
